articles.title: Canada’s top court upholds Quebec law barring public sector workers from wearing religious symbols
articles.highlight: 加拿大最高法院以6比1裁定，魁北克可让第21号法案免受多数侵犯宪章权利的司法挑战。
articles.summary: 加拿大最高法院以6比1多数基本维持魁北克第21号法案，该法禁止公共部门工作人员佩戴显眼宗教标志。裁决允许魁北克援引权利但书，使法案免受大多数基于宪章权利的挑战。此案凸显少数群体权利与政府凌驾这些权利的权力之间的紧张关系，因此受到密切关注。
articles.failureAnalysis: 关键看点是权利但书如何让立法机关在多数情况下压过宪章权利，而非只评判世俗主义政策本身。
articles.sourceExcerpt: Closely watched decision exposes tensions between minority rights and the power of government to override those rights Canada’s top court has largely upheld a controversial secularism law in the province of Quebec barring public sector workers from wearing conspicuous religious symbols, in a closely watched decision that exposes the tensions between minority rights and the power of government to override those rights. In a 6-1 ruling released on Friday morning , the supreme court found Quebec was permitted to shield the law, Bill 21, from most court challenges on the grounds that it violated charter rights.

en.summary: Canada’s Supreme Court largely upheld Quebec’s Bill 21, which bars public sector workers from wearing conspicuous religious symbols, in a 6-1 ruling. The decision allowed Quebec to use the notwithstanding clause to shield the law from most charter-rights challenges. en.failureAnalysis: The key point is how a rights override can let legislators prevail over charter rights in most cases, rather than a simple verdict on secularism policy itself.

articles.title: The Third Thing: Poet Donald Hall on the Secret to Lasting Love
articles.highlight: 第三件事物对婚姻至关重要——物品、实践、习惯、艺术、制度、游戏或人，都能提供共同狂喜或满足的场所。
articles.summary: 文章围绕诗人唐纳德·霍尔关于持久爱情的观点展开，核心是“第三件事物”：夫妻共同投入的对象或实践，能为关系提供共享的喜悦与满足。它值得读，是因为这个比喻简短却实用，能帮助非技术读者理解亲密关系需要共同支点，而不是只靠两个人彼此凝视。
articles.failureAnalysis: 关键启发：稳定的关系往往需要一个双方都能共同投入的“第三件事物”，它可以是习惯、艺术、游戏或共同目标。
articles.sourceExcerpt: "Third things are essential to marriages, objects or practices or habits or arts or institutions or games or human beings that provide a site of joint rapture or contentment."

articles.summary: G2i 创始人 Gabe Greenberg 在 AI Engineer CODE 活动上向 swyx 解释了前沿实验室如何在“高价买独家数据”与“低价买非独家数据”之间做决策，以及小额试点订单如何逐步扩大规模。它值得一读，因为它把训练数据这门生意背后的定价与授权机制讲清楚了，而不只是停留在“数据很贵”这种模糊说法上。
articles.failureAnalysis: 训练数据的价格不取决于数据本身，而取决于排他性：同一份数据卖独家还是卖多家，直接决定了价格与折扣。理解这一点，才能判断数据采购的成本结构和供应商的议价空间。
articles.highlight: 前沿实验室可以为独家保留的训练数据支付更高价格，也可以接受折扣，换取其他实验室也能买到的数据。

en.highlight: A frontier lab can pay more for training data it gets to keep exclusive, or take a discount on data another lab can buy too.
en.summary: At AI Engineer CODE, G2i founder Gabe Greenberg explains to swyx how frontier labs decide between paying a premium for exclusive training data and accepting a discount on non-exclusive data, and how small pilot orders grow into larger deals. It is worth reading because it makes the pricing and licensing mechanics of the training-data business concrete rather than leaving them at a vague "data is expensive."
en.failureAnalysis: The price of training data is driven less by the data itself than by exclusivity: selling the same data to one lab versus many directly sets the price and the discount. Understanding this is what lets you judge the cost structure of data procurement and the bargaining room of suppliers.
en.title: How AI Training Data Is Priced: Exclusive vs. Shared Deals

articles.title: Claude Code’s suggested message feature: I think the real customer is the model
articles.evidenceLabel: Case study + HN discussion + Expert analysis
articles.selectionReason: AI source passed freshness and evidence-chain gate: Case study + HN discussion + Expert analysis
articles.summary: 文章聚焦 Claude Code 的 suggested message 功能，并给出一个反直觉判断：这项能力真正服务的对象可能是模型，而不只是写代码的人。它的价值在于把 AI 编程工具的交互设计放到“模型需要什么输入”这一层来审视；HN 上 270 分、153 条评论也说明该观点引发了较多讨论。
articles.failureAnalysis: 这类“面向模型”的功能可能败在真实需求上：人类用户未必愿意为模型优化额外付出操作或注意力。它还会带来更高的 token/推理成本与延迟，而收益很难用稳定指标验证，模型行为的噪声会让反馈回路放大错误。若只绑定 Claude Code 生态，分发范围也受限；上下文管理、隐私与工程复杂度则是落地约束。

articles.selectionReason: AI source passed freshness and evidence-chain gate: GitHub + Community signal
articles.summary: 该项目展示一个基于 Archon 工作流的“AI 软件工厂”：人负责规划发布和预发布环境测试，系统从 GitHub issue 接收需求，自动构建并输出经独立审查、已合并的 pull request。它值得关注，因为它把 AI 编码从单点助手推进到包含审查与合并环节的交付流水线；但目前信息主要来自仓库描述和 564 星热度，实际能力与适用范围仍需核验。
articles.failureAnalysis: 这类项目最大的风险是演示流程与真实团队交付之间存在差距：自动生成的 PR 能否稳定通过独立审查、测试与合并，取决于代码库复杂度、测试覆盖和权限治理。若只是把 GitHub issue 到 PR 的链路自动化，企业可能认为价值不足以覆盖接入、维护和模型调用成本；预发布测试也仍需人工兜底。当前仅有仓库描述和星数，缺少公开的失败率、成本、合规与数据安全验证，商业化与采用路径存在不确定性。
articles.highlight: 你规划发布，工厂负责构建，你在预发布环境测试；议题进入，经独立审查的合并请求输出，运行在Archon工作流上。
articles.sourceExcerpt: GitHub repository with 564 stars and recent public activity. Description: You plan the release, the factory builds it, you test it in staging. GitHub issues in, independently reviewed and merged pull requests out, all on Archon workflows.

en.highlight: You plan the release, the factory builds it, you test it in staging; GitHub issues go in and independently reviewed, merged pull requests come out on Archon workflows.
en.summary: This project presents an Archon-workflow-based “AI software factory”: humans plan releases and test in staging, while the system takes GitHub issues as input and outputs independently reviewed, merged pull requests. It is worth watching because it moves AI coding from a single-point assistant toward a delivery pipeline that includes review and merge steps; however, the available information comes mainly from the repository description and 564 stars, so its real capabilities and fit still need verification.
en.failureAnalysis: The main risk is the gap between a demo workflow and real team delivery: whether generated PRs consistently pass independent review, tests, and merge depends on codebase complexity, test coverage, and permission governance. With only a repository description and star count, there is little public evidence on failure rates, cost, compliance, or data security, leaving adoption and commercialization uncertain.
en.title: AI Software Factory: From GitHub Issues to Reviewed and Merged Pull Requests
